title: Inlet Box Position Dial
description: The learner moves an inlet box around a drive-side fan view to learn the eight FanPedia positions, then sets the position for eight duct approaches with hints, the correct position and the reason as feedback.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: inlet box
inlet box position
viewed from the drive side
rotation
rights: Copyright 2026 Twin City Fan. All rights reserved.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Inlet box positions seen from the drive side
learningObjectives: The learner will use the drive-side inlet box angle convention to set the correct inlet box position for eight duct-approach descriptions, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: inlet box position numbers and descriptions
inlet box angle versus discharge angle

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); verdicts announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs and solid/dashed borders pair with colour; Left/Right arrow keys move the box; Enter checks and goes to the next duct; every box move is announced.

controls.label: ⟲ Counterclockwise / Clockwise ⟳
controls.purpose: Move the box one position (Left/Right arrow); clicking the drawing also moves it

controls.label: Next duct
controls.purpose: Next duct; See results after duct 8 (Enter)

controls.label: Explore mode
controls.purpose: Back to free exploration after the challenge

rules: Positions 45..360 clockwise from the top as seen from the drive side; 360 is the top
The position does not depend on rotation
Correct only when the position equals the answer; two attempts; first attempt counts; mastery 7 of 8
assumptions: Housing drawn with a top horizontal discharge
limitations: Schematic end view; the box may pass behind the outlet

sources: FanPedia p. 144 (Inlet Boxes: Positions, Inlet Box Positions Determined From Drive Side)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore the fixed clock of positions, then place the box for described ducts and read the number on Check
keyQuestions: Where does the duct arrive, and what is that position's number?
commonMisconceptions: The inlet box angle counts in the direction of rotation
The description alone identifies one position
The inlet box angle is read from the inlet side
assessmentOpportunities: Running line 'Correct on first attempt: n of 8'; mastery is 7 of 8 on the first attempt.
